fact.en: Mistaking Harsha as the founder of the Vardhana dynasty (It was Pushyabhuti).
fact.hi: Mistaking Harsha as the founder of the Vardhana dynasty (It was Pushyabhuti).

fact.en: Assuming Harsha controlled the entire Deccan (He was stopped by Pulakeshin II at the Narmada).
fact.hi: Assuming Harsha controlled the entire Deccan (He was stopped by Pulakeshin II at the Narmada).

fact.en: Believing Harsha was a devout Buddhist from birth (He was initially a Shaivite).
